heading_path: Part 13—Importation of goods infringing Australian trade marks
text: The object of this Part is to protect registered trade marks by making provision allowing the Comptroller-General of Customs to seize and deal with goods that are imported into Australia if the importation infringes, or appears to infringe, a registered trade mark. Note: In addition, the regulations may provide for the effect of a protected international trade mark: see Part 17A.
